TITLE: Emergency Work Order Response Standard
CONTENT: Emergencies include no heat below 40 degrees outdoor temperature, no cooling above 85 degrees indoor temperature, active water intrusion, sewage backup, gas odor, electrical burning smell, and any condition that prevents securing the home. A vendor must acknowledge an emergency within 1 hour and be on site within 4 hours. If no vendor accepts in 30 minutes, the work order escalates automatically to the market maintenance manager. Residents with medically vulnerable household members get priority dispatch.

TITLE: Make-Ready Turnover Checklist
CONTENT: Every vacated home must complete the make-ready checklist before listing. Required steps: move-out inspection with photos, scope approval within 48 hours, pre-move-in pest treatment, HVAC filter replacement and system test, water heater flush, smoke and CO detector test, smart lock reset, utility activation, and a QA inspection with photo upload. The target turn time is 10 days for standard scopes and 21 days for value-add scopes. A failed QA returns the home to the vendor at no additional cost.

TITLE: Renewal Pricing and Retention Guidelines
CONTENT: Renewal offers are generated 75 days before lease expiration using the revenue management model. The model considers comparable market rents, home-level attributes, the resident's tenure and payment history, and portfolio occupancy targets. Community managers may approve retention concessions of up to 2 percentage points below the model offer for residents in good standing. Concessions beyond that require regional director approval. Renewal increases are capped where local regulation requires.

TITLE: Security Deposit Disposition Policy
CONTENT: Deposit dispositions must be issued within the state-mandated timeline, typically 14 to 45 days depending on the state. Deductions require move-out photo evidence and must exclude normal wear and tear. Paint is considered normal wear after 3 or more years of occupancy, and carpet after 5 or more years. Itemized statements must include vendor invoices for any deduction over $250.

TITLE: Moisture and Mold Response Procedure
CONTENT: Any report of visible mold, persistent moisture, or a musty odor requires an inspection within 72 hours, or within 24 hours if a household member has a respiratory condition. The inspector identifies the moisture source first, since remediation without source correction is not allowed. Areas over 10 square feet require a licensed remediation vendor. Temporary lodging is offered when remediation affects bedrooms or when medically advised.

TITLE: Vendor Performance Scorecard
CONTENT: Vendors are scored monthly on SLA compliance, first-time fix rate, QA pass rate, cost versus benchmark, and resident satisfaction. A score under 70 for two consecutive months triggers a performance improvement plan. Preferred vendor status requires a score of 85 or higher, current insurance certificates, and background-checked technicians. Missed scheduled services such as landscaping are logged as scorecard deductions.

TITLE: Preventive Maintenance Program
CONTENT: Each home receives semi-annual HVAC service, before cooling and heating seasons. Filters ship to residents every 60 days. Water heaters older than 10 years are inspected annually and proactively replaced at 12 years or at the first sign of corrosion. Roofs are visually inspected annually. Gutters are cleaned annually, or twice a year in heavily wooded lots.

TITLE: Capital Expenditure Approval Thresholds
CONTENT: Repairs under $2,500 may be approved by the market maintenance manager. Repairs from $2,500 to $10,000 require regional director approval. Repairs over $10,000, roof replacements, sewer line replacements, and HVAC system replacements require asset management approval with a repair-versus-dispose analysis. Insurance claims should be opened for any storm, hail, or water event where damage may exceed the deductible.

TITLE: Early Lease Termination and Transfer Policy
CONTENT: Residents may terminate early with 60 days' notice and a fee equal to one month's rent. Residents relocating between markets in the portfolio may transfer with no termination fee, subject to approval of the new home. Military residents receive protections under the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act. Domestic violence early termination is handled confidentially according to state law.

TITLE: Storm and Hurricane Preparedness
CONTENT: Florida, Texas, and Carolinas markets activate the storm plan 72 hours before projected landfall. Residents receive preparation notices, and vendors are pre-staged for tarping, debris removal, and water mitigation. After the storm, every home in the affected area is surveyed within 5 days, prioritizing homes reporting intrusion or loss of utilities. All damage is photographed for insurance claims.

TITLE: Resident Communication Standards
CONTENT: Resident inquiries via portal, text, or email receive a first response within 4 business hours. Every work order sends status updates at scheduling, dispatch, and completion. Satisfaction surveys are sent within 24 hours of completion. Any rating of 1 or 2 triggers a callback from the community manager within 2 business days.

TITLE: Pest Control Standards
CONTENT: Every turnover requires an interior and exterior pest treatment before move-in, documented in the make-ready record. Resident-reported pest issues within 30 days of move-in are treated at no charge. Florida and Texas homes receive quarterly exterior treatments. Rodent issues require exclusion work, sealing entry points, and not just trapping.

TITLE: Smart Home Device Management
CONTENT: All homes have a smart lock, smart thermostat, and leak sensors under sinks and water heaters. Access codes are rotated at every turnover and vendor codes expire within 24 hours of the scheduled visit. Leak-sensor alerts create an urgent work order automatically. Residents may not remove smart devices, but they may connect them to their own accounts.

TITLE: Delinquency and Payment Plan Procedure
CONTENT: Rent is due on the 1st, and a late fee applies after the 5th unless prohibited locally. Residents experiencing hardship may request a payment plan of up to 3 months. Before filing any eviction, the team must attempt resident outreach on three separate days and refer the resident to rental assistance resources. Bulk fee waivers are issued for payment processor outages.

TITLE: Value-Add Renovation Scope Standards
CONTENT: During turnover, homes in submarkets where rents support a premium of 8% or more are evaluated for value-add upgrades: luxury vinyl plank flooring, quartz countertops, LED lighting, updated fixtures, and smart home packages. Upgrade budgets are capped at $12,000 per home unless approved by asset management. The renovation ROI must exceed 10% based on incremental rent.

TITLE: Build-to-Rent Community Operations
CONTENT: Build-to-rent communities have on-site amenity management, HOA-style rules communicated at lease signing, and builder warranty tracking for the first 24 months. Warranty items must be filed with the builder before using portfolio vendors. Common-area landscaping and amenities follow the community operations calendar.

TITLE: Water Heater Replacement Standard
CONTENT: Replacement water heaters must be at least 50 gallons for homes with four or more bedrooms. They require a drain pan, a leak sensor, and a code-compliant expansion tank. Gas units need a combustion air check. Replacements are scheduled within 24 hours for no-hot-water emergencies.

TITLE: HOA Compliance Management
CONTENT: HOA violation notices must be logged within 1 business day and resolved before the cure deadline. Violations caused by vendor service failures are charged back to the vendor. Violations caused by residents are communicated with the HOA rule excerpt and a cure timeline. Repeat resident violations may result in a lease compliance notice.

TITLE: Resident Move-In Experience
CONTENT: Move-in day requires utilities active, a smart lock code delivered, a welcome packet with HOA rules and the maintenance request guide, a move-in condition report available in the portal for 7 days, and a filter delivery subscription activated. A 7-day post-move-in check-in call is required. Move-in defects found within 7 days are prioritized as urgent.

TITLE: Data Definitions for Operating KPIs
CONTENT: Occupancy = occupied homes divided by total homes in the operating portfolio, excluding homes under renovation over 30 days and homes held for sale. Blended rent growth = weighted average of renewal and new lease rent change. Days to re-lease = days from move-out to the next lease start. Turnover rate = annualized move-outs divided by average occupied homes. Bad debt = uncollectible rent as a percentage of billed rent. These definitions should match Power BI reporting.
